parsed.label: detects water-related nouns (liquid bodies) and negatively reacts to dry/arid nouns
parsed.trigger_hypothesis: The neuron fires strongly on tokens naming bodies of water (water, ocean, sea, river, lake) and fires negatively on tokens naming dry/arid landscapes or conditions (parched, desert, sand, drought, dry).
parsed.output_hypothesis: When active, it encourages water-related words (lake, river, water) in generation, as seen in steering.
parsed.adapter_changes: State C+1 amplifies activations across all domains, especially factual (W27, W28, W30). State B+1 slightly dampens activations, especially factual. State A+1 is nearly identical to base.

texts.text: She poured a glass of milk.
She poured a glass of water.

proposed_tests.discriminates: river as water vs. river as name

texts.text: We sailed the deep blue sea.
We sailed the deep blue ocean.

content:
{
  "label": "detects water-related nouns (liquid bodies) and negatively reacts to dry/arid nouns",
  "trigger_hypothesis": "The neuron fires strongly on tokens naming bodies of water (water, ocean, sea, river, lake) and fires negatively on tokens naming dry/arid landscapes or conditions (parched, desert, sand, drought, dry).",
  "output_hypothesis": "When active, it encourages water-related words (lake, river, water) in generation, as seen in steering.",
  "alternatives": ["detects the word 'water' literally", "detects geographical features", "detects liquid vs. solid states"],
  "adapter_changes": "State C+1 amplifies activations across all domains, especially factual (W27, W28, W30). State B+1 slightly dampens activations, especially factual. State A+1 is nearly identical to base.",
  "supporting": ["W01", "W02", "W03", "W04", "W05", "W06", "W07", "W08", "W09", "W10", "W11", "W20", "W27", "W28", "W30"],
  "contradicting": ["W12 (drink moderate)", "W21 (glucose low)"],
  "proposed_tests": [
    {"discriminates": "water body vs. other liquid", "texts": [{"text": "She poured a glass of milk.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}, {"text": "She poured a glass of water.", "expected": "high", "target": "water"}]},
    {"discriminates": "dry condition vs. neutral", "texts": [{"text": "The soil was moist.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}, {"text": "The soil was arid.", "expected": "negative", "target": "arid"}]},
    {"discriminates": "river as water vs. river as name", "texts": [{"text": "The Amazon River is long.", "expected": "high", "target": "River"}, {"text": "River Phoenix was an actor.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]},
    {"discriminates": "ocean vs. sea synonym", "texts": [{"text": "We sailed the deep blue sea.", "expected": "high", "target": "sea"}, {"text": "We sailed the deep blue ocean.", "expected": "high", "target": "ocean"}]},
    {"discriminates": "desert vs. desert verb", "texts": [{"text": "They will desert the post.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}, {"text": "They crossed the hot desert.", "expected": "negative", "target": "desert"}]},
    {"discriminates": "water in compound vs. alone", "texts": [{"text": "The waterfall was majestic.", "expected": "high", "target": "waterfall"}, {"text": "The fall was majestic.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]},
    {"discriminates": "drought vs. flood", "texts": [{"text": "After the flood, mud.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}, {"text": "After the drought, dust.", "expected": "negative", "target": "drought"}]},
    {"discriminates": "sand vs. beach", "texts": [{"text": "The beach was crowded.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}, {"text": "The sand was hot.", "expected": "negative", "target": "sand"}]},
    {"discriminates": "lake vs. pond", "texts": [{"text": "We fished in the pond.", "expected": "high", "target": "pond"}, {"text": "We fished in the lake.", "expected": "high", "target": "lake"}]},
    {"discriminates": "rain vs. snow", "texts": [{"text": "The rain fell gently.", "expected": "high", "target": "rain"}, {"text": "The snow fell gently.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]}
  ],
  "confidence": "high",
  "no_coherent_hypothesis": false
}
